name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.2-beta

- Edit layout, Quick play, trailers, Movies & TV in search, send everything to Simkl
  - Edit layout: one screen (Settings → UI, or "Edit layout" at the end of Home, Movies & TV and Manga) for every page. Reorder, hide, rename and add rows; each row gets its own card style, size, row or grid, item count and order. Add filtered AniList rows (genres, year, minimum score, sort) or any Movies & TV catalog (optionally one genre). Library: default sort, order and columns per list type. Replaces the Movies & TV row editor; Home's list switches stay in step with it.
  - Home and Anime in one tab: the Anime tab's rows (Recently Updated, Trending, Popular, Recently Completed, Upcoming, …) are now Home rows you can mix with your own lists.
  - Quick play: Play starts your usual stream (same addon and quality) without the list when it's there; long-press Play to choose. Switch in Stremio account → Playback.
  - Trailer button on Movies & TV pages (opens in YouTube).
  - Search: a Movies & TV tab next to the anime results (anime results unchanged).
  - Settings → Accounts → "Send everything to Simkl": your Movies & TV watch history (episodes in progress included) and your AniList anime list (status, progress, scores). Safe to run again.
